lines.en: label wakanadate25p2:
scene noonsky
My coworker or friend or whatever she’s supposed to be shows up not long after I step outside and I notice that she’s completely empty-handed.
So either she’s given up on pursuing something she thought was important just moments ago or my inability to help her forced her out of the shop without so much as a free bookmark.
Either way, I manage to come out on top this time — which mirrors the exact position I always end up taking in my fantasies of her.
I wouldn’t be surprised if those stopped for a little while now.
There’s a right time and a wrong time to pressure people into revealing their troubles to you, and I like to believe I’m a lot better when it comes to eying the clock than Wakana is.
That could very well just be something I believe though. When, in all actuality, I may have been on the exact opposite end of things in the past.
It’s possible I pressure everyone all the time by just being me.

It’s possible that every single interaction I’ve ever had with someone younger and more naive than me involved me pressuring them in some way because that’s just how these sorts of relationships work.
Being on the other end of that isn’t fun.
It’s scary.
And I’d much prefer not being pressured into things anymore.
I have been good all day.
I do not deserve to be punished like this.
: Arakawa.
scene wakanawalk1
: It is clear that I have overstepped a boundary of yours, and I apologize for that.

: It wasn’t my intention to trap you into assisting me in what is sure to be another fruitless endeavor. But my endless thirst for all things dark and disturbing drives me to act inappropriately at times.
: I have, once again, let that get the better of me and cornered you in a way that I do not feel good about.
: Do you ever feel good about anything?
scene wakanawalk2
: Not really, no. Which likely contributes to my interest in all things black and dreary.
: It is what it is. There’s no need to formally apologize when I never gave you something this professional after literally pushing you up against a wall.
: That is true. But I am a much better person than you are and clearly value this friendship a whole lot more. So please do not hold this apology against me in any form.
: I will stop pestering you about it for now and attempt to learn more on my own. But there is one more thing I’d like to say first.
: Me too. And I’d like to say my piece before you say yours.
scene wakanawalk3
: Feel free.
: Stop trying to “learn” more on your own.
: This whole thing...just give up. It’s probably just some sort of coincidence in the first place.
: Is that really something you expect me to believe given the reaction you’ve had on multiple occasions now? This is no coincidence, Arakawa.
: If you want to refuse to divulge information to me, fine. But don’t just outright lie to me. That’s rude.
: I just think you’d be happier if you remained ignorant. That’s all.
: Getting involved in another family’s affairs is meaningless when you have your own troubles to worry about.
: I wouldn’t have chosen this line of work if I wanted to remain invested in naught but my own issues. And I would not be wasting my time with you if that was a factor either.
scene wakanawalk4
: I’m a gleeful woman, full of joy and rainbows, who simply wants to spread happiness all across the land.
: How hard was that to say on a scale of one to ten?
scene wakanawalk5
: Fifty. But if straightforward compassion will not reach you, I figured sarcasm might. That’s more your speed, isn’t it?
: If you want to be compassionate, stay out of this. For me.
: So you can keep sulking and pretending you don’t love the things I know you do?
: So I don’t revert to something even worse.
: It might not seem like it to you, but I’ve made some major strides lately. In a lot of different ways.
: But there are things I’m not ready to deal with yet and this is one of them. And I’m sure it’s the same for Ami. So if you really want to be compassionate, mind your own business. Please.
scene wakanawalk6
: Is that really what you want? To go it alone rather than lean on someone who cares about you?
: You expect me to think you care about me after inviting me out just to satisfy your own curiosity? And then questioning me about a thing you know sets me off?
scene wakanawalk7
: That might have been how it seemed, but-
: I was actually looking forward to hanging out with you without there being some ulterior motive for once. Then this happened. But I guess that’s on me for agreeing to come in the first place.
: Arakawa-
: What did you want to say? Sorry for interrupting. Mine took a little longer than I thought it would.
scene wakanawalk8
: Do you know why I wanted you to write something for the contest? And why I was so furious when you didn’t?
: Because poetry turns you on.

: No, you fucking imbecile. It’s because I have to see your disgusting, expressionless face every single day while knowing damn well that you are suppressing something and making yourself even uglier.
scene wakanawalk9

: Even if you don’t share it with anyone, writing can help you with your feelings. You can let them out without dragging anyone else down in the process. And that’s something you’re afraid of, isn’t it?
: Have you stopped to think that maybe I just don’t like writing anymore?
: No, because that’s stupid and you’re lying when you say that.
: I’m proud that you’re allegedly making these alleged strides and that you’re allegedly not as bad as you allegedly used to be. But if you want to make a real stride...write.
: That’s all I wanted to tell you before we drop this altogether.
: I’ll think about it, Wakana. But I’m kind of mad at you right now.
scene wakanawalk10
: Hah...again, I apologize. You’re not the only one who struggles to properly convey their thoughts and feelings, you know.
: Yes. I may despise every fiber of your being. But it’s not as if I actually dislike you.
: Wow, you really are bad at conveying your thoughts and feelings if that is the pitch you’re going to use to highlight our apparent friendship.
: Arakawa, I despise every fiber of every person’s being. And I wish humanity as a whole would just fall into a sinkhole and die sometimes.
: Don’t wish for that too hard or it might just happen again.
: Sometimes I believe that my constant wishing for that is why it happened to our rival school in the first place. But that is beside the point.
: Yes, I hate everyone. And everyone includes you.
scene wakanawalk11
: But I am glad you are a part of my life. And the reason I’m so hard on you all the time is because I know you can be so much more than you are now. You just won’t. And that pisses me off.
: Again, I’m trying to get better. It’s just taking a really long time.
: Well, there will always be an option there to speed it up should your backbone ever regrow.
: I’ll keep that in mind. Thanks.
scene wakanawalk12
: Fine. I suppose that’s all I can ask for.
: I’m still mad at you, though.
: Are you ten years old?
: No. Just betrayed.
: Would carrying me around help you feel better?
: I can’t imagine it would, Wakana.
: Are you absolutely sure?
: I am absolutely sure, yes.
scene wakanawalk13
: You’re positive?
: I’m positive.
: There’s not a question in your mind?
: Wakana, what is this?
scene wakanawalk14
: Arakawa, I’m well aware this is probably the worst possible time for this, but I need you to carry me.
: Excuse me?
: It’s a long story. But I’m in excruciating pain right now and I am probably going to collapse if we keep walking.
: Did you really try to trick me into thinking I wanted to do this instead of just asking?
scene wakanawalk15
: Yes. Because ideally, you would have agreed and I wouldn’t have had to explain myself. It would have looked like me giving you a reward.
: You really can’t walk?

: I can not. And in a perfect world, I’d have pills with me to help for cases like this. But I have proven to be irresponsible with them and will no longer carry them when I don’t expect to be going places.
: I guess that’s something you should have thought about before inviting me miles away from school and then proceeding to make me mad.
: As fun and peppy as your grumpy side can be, Arakawa- my legs are starting to shake and you are an able-bodied man who has recently proven to have a great deal of stamina.
: I’m never going to let you live this down, you know.
: Oh, I’m well aware of that. But the alternative in this case is lying on the sidewalk until Osako can come pick me up.
: There’s no other option?
: There’s no other option.
: Buy me dinner.
: Deal.
scene black
scene wakanawalk16
It’s a lot harder to be mad at someone with their legs wrapped around you and their chin resting on your shoulder. I learned that today.
It’s actually easier to be mad at someone while you’re having sex with them than this. This is just...uncomfortable.
But strangely enough, it doesn’t seem that way for Wakana.
Which tricks me into believing, once again, that maybe she does value me. And maybe she wasn’t just trying to use me for her own benefit today.
But I have a hard time believing that when it comes to people who aren’t naive. And Wakana is anything but.
I know she sees through me. And I feel that, at often times, I let her because I want her to realize how broken I am.
But then she does...and I don’t like it. So I backtrack and try to make things normal again, only to realize that it’s far too late.
And now here she is...defenseless and just inches away from my face. But I have no desire to walk her down a dark alley and seize the day.
Instead...I just want to look at her.
To peer into the eyes of someone who doesn’t care for my shiny coat of paint or my polychromatic mask.
And to get lost in her when I know with all of my decaying heart that I shouldn’t.
: Is this weird for you?
: A little. But I’ve gotten used to it over the years.
: Is this a common occurrence for you or was that more sarcasm?
: It’s a relatively common occurrence, unfortunately. But modern medicine has made it mostly manageable. And my partner can carry me across all of Japan without so much as breaking a sweat.
: It’s really only an issue when I find myself miles from home with strange men. Which, needless to say, has happened a grand total of one time in recent memory.
: Is this, like...the result of some kind of accident or something? Or were you just born weak?
scene wakanawalk17
: I suppose it would be a little bit of both.
: It’s not a very interesting story, but I believe I owe you at least some amount of uninhibited chatter on account of how unmistakably unfriendly I’ve been today.
: That was a lot of “uns” for one sentence.
scene wakanawalk18
: Do you want to hear why I’m making you do this or not?
: My bad. Go ahead.
: Okay. But again, it’s not very interesting.
: Then maybe I don’t want to hear it after all.
: Well, too bad because here it comes.
scene wakanawalk19
: I was born well before I was meant to be — which resulted in a slew of health issues that I’ve been dealing with for my entire life. Some more severe than others.
: Among those issues was the malformation of my spine.
: Thankfully, I was born to a wealthy family that was able to afford the corrective surgery needed to repair it.
: Unthankfully, even the most experienced of surgeons in the most prestigious of hospitals can’t help but make mistakes sometimes. They’re human, after all. That sort of thing is inevitable.

: I’m sure I don’t have to tell you this, but the spine is a fragile thing. One wrong move or injury to that part of the body could leave you paralyzed for life. So I’m lucky I got off with just this.
: I was not lucky enough to be gifted an entirely normal life, though — and I’ve been mildly useless in all things physical ever since.
scene wakanawalk20
: Well...almost all things. I still excel in a few...select areas.
: I’m happy for Osako.
scene wakanawalk21
: As you should be. But there are a few more appropriate areas I was able to manage in as well. Like kyudo.
: Isn’t that really taxing on a person’s back, though?
: Very. And when I was going to Higashigaoka, my doctors advised that I pursue something else instead at the risk of further harming myself.
: But you disregarded their opinions and kept doing kyudo anyway?
: Yes. But also no. I was never able to compete in tournaments, but I could still shoot two days out of the week. But that was enough for me back then.
: And more than enough for me now to become the instructor of a bunch of public school girls without any experience. And also Ushibori, who is just...very good, for some reason.
: She’s from Nara. They're probably more interested in boring stuff like archery out there.
: That explains a few things. Also, fuck you.
: What other health issues do you have as a result of your...early birth thing? You said there were more, right?
: A few. But I think one is enough for today. It’s not as if hearing any of the others will assist in explaining why I’m making you carry me.
: Is your back okay in that position? Do I need to, like...adjust you or anything?
: This is plenty, Arakawa. Thank you.
: Don’t worry about it. You could have just told me this earlier instead of trying to trick me into carrying you, though.
: Excuse me, are you telling me to be more open about my insecurities and the things that hold me back in life?
: Touché.
: Touché indeed.
scene wakanawalk22
: I wonder what Osako would say if she saw us like this.
scene black
: Don’t.
